pearls.purpose: AI model hub pearl — register Ollama / OpenAI / OpenRouter providers, manage per-model connections, expose AI capabilities to peer Pearls via Grapple. The pearl itself doesn't talk to the public internet directly; one HTTP_COMPONENT sidecar mediates every provider call. Inference transcripts are pinned to the user's Solana wallet so they're tamper-evident and citable across Pearls.

offers.name: ai-text
offers.purpose: Generic text / chat completion — the consuming pearl picks model class; this pearl picks provider.

offers.name: ai-vision
offers.purpose: Image understanding + OCR. Same routing model as ai-text.

offers.name: ai-generic
offers.purpose: Open-ended capability — the user picks the exact model in the Grapple UI at grant time.

encryption.scheme: AES-256-GCM via grain-crypto-journal envelope; transcripts wallet-anchored
fields: Provider API keys (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama tokens)

adminOnly.name: Configure provider credentials
adminOnly.purpose: Owner-only: add / rotate / revoke provider credentials. OTP-gated.

adminOnly.name: Manage Grapple consumers
adminOnly.purpose: Decide which peer Pearls may claim ai-text / ai-vision / ai-generic.

anyMember.name: Run inference
anyMember.purpose: Anyone with a Grapple cap can request inference; routing is scoped to that cap.

anyMember.name: Pin a transcript
anyMember.purpose: Wallet-OTP signs the transcript; anchored on-chain via release-entry pattern.

blockchains.purpose: Release attestation. Pinned-transcript anchors are off-chain ed25519 over the canonical transcript hash, signed by the user's wallet.

httpOut.purpose: All AI provider API calls — never directly from the pearl, only through the HTTP_COMPONENT sidecar.
